text:
kai: quick UX ask: the approval toast copy currently says "Approved" (past tense) but the audit log uses present-tense verb fields. proposing we standardize to present tense everywhere for clarity: e.g., "Approve" -> action label, toast reads "Approved 3 tests" (maybe keep past tense?) thoughts? link mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/approval-audit-tense.png

meera: short: consistency matters for alerts and logs. my vote: UI action labels = imperative (Approve), toasts = past tense (Approved 3 tests.), audit log = past tense with actor/time (Kai approved 3 tests). Keeps intent clear.

kai: fair. i'm worried toasts that read "Approved 3 tests" might sound final without offering undo. propose toast: "Approved 3 tests. Undo" and make Undo a focusable button with role=status announced.

sam: agree. accessibility: toast should be in a `role="status"` container and Undo should be reachable by keyboard. Also ensure the toast includes `data-action-id` so analytics can capture clicks.

elaine: microcopy nit: when there are mixed outcomes (e.g., 2 approved, 1 skipped due to conflict), toast should be explicit: "Approved 2 tests; 1 skipped (conflict). Undo". short and scannable.

meera: another UX point: audit trail detail modal (click actor -> view) should show the exact commit-like diff of what changed (which tests moved state) and a small verb timeline: "Kai approved" -> timestamp. ensure verbs are past tense there.

kai: switching topic: density slider for diffs in scorecard. added a prototype slider that changes diff granularity: compact (1 line), default (3 lines), expanded (full). concerns: keyboard accessibility and announcements when density changes. mock: https://img.redwood.dev/mock/density-slider.png

sam: slider a11y: use a proper range input with aria-label "Diff density" and add live region announcement: "Diff density set to compact". but a semantic slider may imply numeric value; include discrete ticks labeled Compact / Default / Expanded and `aria-valuetext` mapping.

elaine: UI: when users move to compact, we should hide comment previews but keep a tiny icon indicating the presence of notes (e.g., speech bubble with count). don't remove content entirely to avoid surprise.

meera: performance note: expanding lots of diffs might be heavy. lazy-render expansions and remember user preference per workspace. also add a small cog to revert to run-default density.

kai: keyboard control idea: allow `[` and `]` to cycle density with a tooltip hint. make sure localized key labels displayed in the hint modal.

aria_bot: accessibility-check: recommended slider semantics: use `<input type="range" min=1 max=3 step=1>` with `aria-valuetext` for labels. Ensure contrast on slider thumb >= 3:1 and focus ring >= 3px. For toast undo, ensure it has `aria-live="polite"` and that it does not steal focus.

sam: analytics: track `ui.density.change` with `from_value`/`to_value`, and `approve.toast.undo_click`. also record `audit.view.open` events. keep names kebab-case.

elaine: small copy: slider tooltip when hovering tick should read e.g., "Compact (1 line)" not just "Compact" so users know what changes. also ensure mobile uses segmented control instead of tiny slider.

kai: action items: (kai) update PR with toast copy examples + mixed-outcome templates (2267890130), (sam) add aria-live + undo focus behavior in prototype, (meera) add audit modal wire and verb-tense rules to UX doc, (elaine) spec slider fallback for mobile and tooltip copy. I'll push a tiny HTML demo for screenreaders in the PR. thanks! :thumbsup:
